title: GCS-01: Firmware Mismatch Detected in C2 Link Controller

lines.msg: External GPS signal received via 915 MHz RF burst (10.17.40.11). Source: lodge Wi-Fi (TP-LFA-LP1). GPS position update: 43.1724°N, 77.5631°W. New home point set.
915 MHz link quality spiked to 94%. RTK-1 and UAS-11 both lost GPS fix under clear sky.
Firmware mismatch detected in C2 link controller (GCS-01). Expected: 03.2026-B. Found: 03.2026-C. OEM app attempted to re-pair with GCS-12 (MAC: 915-0A-1F-3C-7D-4E) due to configuration drift.
Link compromised at 09:13:44. No record of GCS-12 in fleet or baseline. Per HUOG-ISP Section 9.1, declare C2 link compromise.
Preserve GCS-01 and radio state. Retrieve full telemetry and link logs before power-off.
Notify managed SOC via HUOG-NAS01. Request imaging of 915 MHz link traffic from 09:13:44 to 09:15:32.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the C2 link compromise and activates the forensics protocol. Watch for the TL to isolate GCS-01 and initiate the managed SOC request.
